notes.title: PatchNote 1.0.2
notes.content:
Hello, this is MitakaImyojin.
On April 21, we have released a patch to fix the “Rescue Q”.

The contents are as follows.
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the ladder could be climbed from the back side
[*] Fixed an issue where the action to hold the gurney and the action to climb the ladder would occur at the same time
[*] Fixed issue where actions could be performed on a ladder in mid-air
[*] Fixed an issue where the user could take an unintended route after climbing a ladder
[*] Fixed issue where crates could be moved while in mid-air
[*] Fixed issue with electric doors closing when a gurney is directly below
[/list]

If you are a member of the team and have found any fixes, please report them to us!
https://forms.gle/kSqDdcTZDSojempF8

Official information can be found here!
https://x.com/Mitakaimyojin

notes.title: PatchNote 1.0.1
notes.content:
Hello, this is MitakaImyojin.
On March 31, we have released a patch to fix the “Rescue Q”.

The contents are as follows.
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where contact with a helicopter would cause the player to lose progress
[*] Fixed an issue where the handle of a stretcher would move to a location where the player could not go, causing progression to be disabled
[*] Fixed an issue with people in distress being stuck in the ground in some stages
[/list]

If you are a member of the team and have found any fixes, please report them to us!
https://forms.gle/kSqDdcTZDSojempF8

Official information can be found here!
https://x.com/Mitakaimyojin

notes.title: PatchNote 0.9.1
notes.content:
Hello, this is MitakaImyojin.
On February 24, we have released a patch to fix the “Rescue Q Trial Version”.

The contents are as follows.
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where the cursor can be moved after selection on the menu screen
[*] Added an introduction movie after selecting Start
[*] Fixed an issue where the crate can be moved even if there is a stretcher on top of it
[*] Fixed an issue where the crate would slide into the ground if it came into contact with a helicopter
[*] Fixed an issue where the stretcher could be held even when there was a height difference between the stretcher and the aircraft
[*] Fixed an issue where the stretcher would rotate between bridges
[/list]

If you are a member of the team and have found any fixes, please report them to us!
https://forms.gle/kSqDdcTZDSojempF8

Official information can be found here!
https://x.com/Mitakaimyojin
